## What this is

A reproducible R pipeline that nowcasts Australian quarterly Net
Overseas Migration (NOM) from public data only, and republishes the
result as a static website on a weekly cadence. The site you're
reading is regenerated from scratch by a GitHub Actions workflow that
fetches the latest ABS / DHA data, refits the model, and pushes the
rendered HTML to GitHub Pages.

The codebase is on GitHub: [DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast](https://github.com/DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast).
Pull requests welcome.

## Data sources

| Source | What | Update cadence | Publication lag |
|--------|------|----------------|-----------------|
| ABS Overseas Arrivals and Departures (cat. 3401.0) | Long-term arrivals / departures by visa group | Monthly | ~5 weeks |
| ABS Quarterly Population Estimates (cat. 3101.0) | Headline NOM total | Quarterly | ~6 months |
| ABS Overseas Migration (cat. 3407.0) | Annual NOM by 4-category visa breakdown | Annual (FY) | ~9 months |
| Department of Home Affairs (via data.gov.au CKAN) | Visa grants by program (Student, Visitor, Skilled, Working Holiday, Temporary Graduate) | Quarterly | ~45 days |

All sources are accessible via free public APIs / file downloads.
Fetchers live in [`R/ingest/`](https://github.com/DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast/tree/main/R/ingest).

## Limitations

- **No private microdata.** Without PLIDA-level stay-duration data the
  model can't directly observe the 12/16-month rule. It estimates the
  OAD-to-NOM mapping empirically from completed cohorts.
- **No granular quarterly visa breakdown.** ABS retired quarterly
  NOM-by-visa publication. The model uses annual FY visa data
  broadcast across quarters via OAD-arrival proportions.
- **Pseudo-real-time backtest only.** The site has no vintage
  history yet — at each backtest as-of date the underlying data
  values are today's values, restricted to what would have been
  publicly observable then. A true vintage backtest will accumulate
  as the pipeline runs weekly.
- **Uncertainty intervals are not full Bayesian.** They come from the
  Kalman filter's MLE point estimate, not from posterior sampling.
  Phase 3 (Stan hierarchical model, [scaffold](https://github.com/DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast/blob/main/stan/hierarchical_nom.stan)) targets proper posterior intervals.

## How the site is built

```
Weekly cron (Mondays 06:00 UTC)
  │
  ├── GitHub Actions: ubuntu-latest runner
  │     │
  │     ├── Install R 4.5.3 (RSPM binaries)
  │     ├── Install Quarto CLI
  │     ├── Restore renv-pinned packages
  │     │
  │     ├── targets::tar_make()
  │     │     ├── Fetch ABS OAD via {readabs}
  │     │     ├── Fetch ABS NOM (cat. 3101.0)
  │     │     ├── Fetch DHA visa grants via data.gov.au CKAN
  │     │     ├── Build quarterly panel
  │     │     ├── Estimate pi (empirical + smoothed)
  │     │     ├── Fit univariate Kalman per category (Phase 1)
  │     │     ├── Fit multivariate Kalman with Gamma lag (Phase 2 v4.0)
  │     │     ├── Run benchmarks (bridge, RW, AR1)
  │     │     └── Run pseudo-real-time backtest
  │     │
  │     ├── quarto render  (this site)
  │     └── peaceiris/actions-gh-pages → gh-pages branch
  │
  └── GitHub Pages serves _site/ from gh-pages branch
```

End-to-end build time: ~10-15 minutes.

## Model architecture in one paragraph

A bivariate state-space Kalman with three observation rows — OAD
long-term arrivals, lagged visa grants, and quarterly NOM itself —
all loading on a single latent log-arrivals state with a damped
local-linear trend and quarterly seasonal. Visa grants are
state-augmented with a discretised Gamma lag (mode at 1 quarter,
4-quarter tail). The headline NOM forecast comes directly from the
latent state via a calibrated offset, bypassing the empirical-π
extrapolation that earlier model versions relied on. Full equations
on the [Methodology](methodology.qmd) page.

## Contributing

The codebase uses standard R/`{targets}`/Quarto idioms. Open issues
and PRs are welcome:

- [Open issues](https://github.com/DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast/issues)
- [Open pull request](https://github.com/DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast/pulls)
- [STATUS.md](https://github.com/DavidAStephan/NOM_Nowcast/blob/main/STATUS.md) lists the current model version, recent
  backtest numbers, and the open punch-list.

Areas that could use help:

- **Phase 3 Stan model** — the scaffold compiles but hasn't been
  calibrated on the live panel.
- **Per-category modelling.** Currently the multivariate fit is
  aggregate only. Per-visa-category fits with cross-category
  partial pooling would give a category decomposition of the
  headline.
- **Better leading indicators.** Department of Education student
  enrolments and BITRE airline passenger data are obvious candidates;
  both sources have moved to Power BI dashboards behind the public
  download URLs and need re-wiring via data.gov.au or alternative
  endpoints.
